title: Runbook: Widget Restart
content:
# Widget restart

When the widget service stalls, restart it.

```bash
systemctl restart widget.service
systemctl status widget.service
```

The Widget dashboard shows WIDGET_OK once it is back.
   indented widget line with leading spaces
widget widget widget
